blocks.label: The giant fibre
blocks.desc: 2 neurons. The famous escape wire, straight from the eyes to the legs.

blocks.label: The steering pair
blocks.desc: 2 neurons that turn the fly (one per side).

blocks.label: All brain-to-body cables
blocks.desc: 1,299 descending neurons: every command that leaves the brain.

blocks.label: Mouth & neck motor neurons
blocks.desc: 105 motor neurons that live in the brain, including the tongue.

blocks.label: Taste sensors
blocks.desc: 408 taste neurons: sugar, bitter, water, on the tongue and legs.

blocks.label: Object detectors
blocks.desc: 8,038 visual projection neurons: 'something is there', 'something is coming'.

blocks.label: The optic lobes (half the brain!)
blocks.desc: 77,530 neurons that process raw pixels behind each eye.

blocks.label: Memory centre
blocks.desc: 5,177 Kenyon cells: the mushroom body, where a fly learns.

blocks.label: Dopamine: reward & punishment
blocks.desc: 331 dopamine neurons that teach the memory centre.

blocks.label: Smell centre
blocks.desc: 3,417 neurons of the antennal lobe: the nose of the brain.

blocks.label: Navigation centre
blocks.desc: 2,875 central complex neurons: the fly's compass.

blocks.label: The whole LEFT half
blocks.desc: 69,000 neurons: everything on the left side.

blocks.label: The whole RIGHT half
blocks.desc: 69,000 neurons: everything on the right side.

blocks.label: A random 5%
blocks.desc: 6,900 neurons picked at random. Different every pull.

blocks.label: A random 20%
blocks.desc: 27,700 neurons picked at random. Different every pull.
